verdict.rationale: The audit half is well documented. The Query History page monitors queries executed by users over the last 14 days, and the ACCESS_HISTORY view in ACCOUNT_USAGE/ORGANIZATION_USAGE records reads and writes for compliance auditing, including which tables and columns were accessed. Column-level lineage of where data came from is only implied by column access tracking and write records; no evidence describes source-to-target column lineage. missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation (source-to-target mapping or lineage graph), retention details for access history beyond the 14-day Query History window, independent or hands-on corroboration.
